page_title: IPS 0-2 LIV | Ipswich v Liverpool 17/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom left corner, but Alisson keeps it out with an amazing save.
90+7' Leif Davis (Ipswich) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

90+6' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman makes the right call and Ipswich will have a corner.
90+5' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+4' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

90+4' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the right-hand post. However, he couldn't beat Christian Walton, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
90+2' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90+2' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
89' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
84' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
81' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' The linesman raises his flag. Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich) is adjudged offside.
79' Substitution. Andrew Robertson makes his way off the pitch and Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) comes on as his replacement.
79' Substitution. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) on for Diogo Jota.
77' The substitution is prepared. Conor Bradley (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Trent Alexander-Arnold.
74' Kieran McKenna prepares a substitution. Axel Tuanzebe is replaced by Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich).
74' Substitution. Liam Delap did his best and is replaced by Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich).
71' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Christian Walton is equal to it and makes an easy save.
69' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
69' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Mohamed Salah.
65' 0 - 2 Goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:2.
65' Kieran McKenna decides to make a substitution. Conor Chaplin will be replaced by Marcus Harness (Ipswich).
65' Substitution. Massimo Luongo is replaced by Jack Taylor (Ipswich).
63' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
63' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.
60' 0 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Diogo Jota (Liverpool) was set free in the area by Mohamed Salah and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the left side of the net. 0:1.
59' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) latches onto a lofted pass from Trent Alexander-Arnold on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
59' Wow, what an escape. Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
57' We are about to witness a subsitution. Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) for Wes Burns.
55' One of the Liverpool players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
55' Referee Tim Robinson signals NO PENALTY for Ipswich after a VAR review!
54' Celebrations by Ipswich are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
53' That is a penalty kick for Ipswich. Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) commits a rough foul. Tim Robinson stops the game and makes a call.
48' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.

47' The ball from the corner kick lands at the feet of Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) deep inside the box and he takes a shot. The strike heads towards the bottom left corner, but it's deflected away thanks to a brilliant intervention by one of the defenders.
47' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) will take the corner.
46' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
46' Arne Slot makes a switch. Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is coming on in place of Jarell Quansah at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Tim Robinson blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) receives a reproachful look from Mohamed Salah. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
43' The resulting set piece from Ipswich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
41' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
40' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
39' The referee blows his whistle after Wes Burns (Ipswich) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. Liverpool will take a free kick near the side line.
39' The total number of attempts is 3:2. The shots on goal statistics – 2:0.
34' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
33' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
32' Some great play by Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Alisson sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
31' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
31' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
28' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and it's Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
28' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
26' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends the corner into the box, but Christian Walton intercepts it and averts the threat.
24' The referee is firm and issues Wes Burns (Ipswich) a deserved yellow card.

20' Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header would probably have ended up low inside the middle of the goal, but Alisson pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
20' It seemed like Samy Morsy (Ipswich) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
17' The corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is intercepted by Christian Walton.
17' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
15' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
15' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool).
13' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
10' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

9' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
7' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) commits a foul and Tim Robinson immediately signals a free kick.
7' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
6' Luke Woolfenden (Ipswich) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
5' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Samy Morsy (Ipswich) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
